name: session-events
description: One daemon per session, a background task of that session, polls any source and delivers its events as messages in the peer envelope, with no text quoted from the polled system, and as a log agents read with wait.

interface.shortDescription: Events from any polled system delivered as messages, not polls.
interface.longDescription: One daemon per Claude Code session, a background task that ends with it, polls a source for the targets the session watches and delivers each poll's events as one message in the peer envelope, with no text quoted from the polled system, and as a log agents read with wait. A source is a script of a few lines: what a target is, how it is read, what its events say. The GitHub source ships as the watch-github skill; a file source ships as the worked example.
defaultPrompt: Tell me when this build log changes.
Watch this queue and message me when a job lands.
Write a source that polls our deploy status.
